deciding_facts.fact: Gap between consecutive fixes inside the trip (14:11:30 to 14:19:00), covering the KPE/MCE stretch the rider disputes
Straight-line jump between the bounding fixes (1.355532,103.896328) -> (1.287039,103.862588)
trace_distance_km (recomputed: 6.178 km pre-gap + 8.490 km straight line across gap + 2.933 km post-gap); admissibility IMPAIRED, GPS_GAP, weight 0.6
actual_distance_km is the trace figure rounded; trip_completed event says the meter ran on the driver-app GPS trace (the exported trace) - not independent of EV-GPS-04003
distance_charged_km is a copy of the trace figure; erp_gantries empty, so no gantry places the vehicle off-corridor
Only two pre-trip pickup messages; no driver admission about the route
Traffic advisory MISSING, weight 0.0, cited by no party

reasoning:
1. Scope and identity. ROUTE_DEVIATION, rider-filed, no safety/complaint flag: in scope under POL-GEN-08(1). trip_id TRP-04003 matches on EV-TRIP-04003, EV-GPS-04003 and EV-FARE-04003; trip started_at/ended_at equal the first/last GPS fixes (14:00:10, 14:26:06), timestamps causally ordered - POL-RD-08(a) met, POL-RD-10(2) and (4) do not fire. Fare model METERED (POL-RD-11 not engaged), vehicle RYDE_X (POL-RD-12 not engaged), no pickup/dropoff amendment (POL-RD-05 not engaged).
2. Measurement (POL-RD-01). Haversine (R 6371.0088) over the 113 fixes: pre-gap 6.178 km + gap straight line 8.4896 km + post-gap 2.9327 km = 17.6004 km = trace_distance_km. Excess = 17.6004 - 13.5 = 4.1004 km = 30.37% of optimal: above 20% and above 0.8 km, below 50% and 8.0 km, so on the trace as measured the deviation would be established and non-material. The clean pre-gap fixes show the vehicle running north to about lat 1.3814 (2.66 km from the pickup, the Buangkok direction) and back south to a point 0.74 km from the pickup by 14:11:30, consistent with the rider's account.
3. Policy-level impairment (POL-RD-07). Within the disputed segment the trace has a 450 s gap (> 90 s, limb (a)) and an 8,489.6 m consecutive-fix jump (> 500 m, limb (b)); the gap covers exactly the KPE/MCE stretch the rider complains of. The trace is therefore impaired for policy purposes, not merely schema-impaired. Under limb (i) the gap is measured as the straight line (already how 17.600 is built). Under limb (ii) a deviation may NOT be established on the gps_trace alone; an independent corroborating source is required. Checking each listed source: chat_log EV-CHAT-04003 holds only two pre-trip pickup messages, no driver admission; fare_breakdown EV-FARE-04003 charges no ERP gantries, so none places the vehicle off the optimal corridor; counterparty_statement is null; trip_record.actual_distance_km (17.6) is the trace figure rounded to 1 dp and the trip_completed event states the meter ran on the driver-app GPS trace, i.e. the same export, so it is not independently derived; the billed distance 17.60 km is likewise a copy of the trace and is expressly excluded as corroboration. No corroboration exists, so limb (iii): the claim is not sustained on the present record and the outcome is ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION.
4. POL-RD-10(3) fires on the same facts (trace impaired under POL-RD-07(a)/(b) with no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration); escalation is terminal and replaces any monetary ruling (POL-GEN-03). POL-RD-08(b) likewise requires the excess to be shown from an unimpaired trace or an independent source, which the rider cannot do on this record.
5. Confidence (POL-GEN-02(2)). The deciding fact - the excess distance - is carried solely by EV-GPS-04003 at weight 0.6 (GPS_GAP, HIGH); trip_record.actual_distance_km may not be cited for the threshold test (POL-RD-01) and is not independent in any case. Confidence is capped at 0.6 < 0.70, so POL-RD-10(1) fires independently as a second escalation trigger.
6. Clauses considered and not applied: POL-RD-03/POL-RD-13 - no party asserts a traffic cause and the MISSING advisory EV-ADVIS-04003-01 is cited by no one, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged; POL-RD-04/POL-RD-14 - no rider instruction in chat; POL-RD-06 - deviation_flags_90d 0 of 245 completed_trips_90d, no pattern, and the deviation would not be material anyway; POL-RD-08 profile limb - deviation_claims_60d 1 (< 4), not engaged; POL-RD-09 - no ERP or surcharge lines, nothing phantom; POL-RD-10(6),(7),(8) - not engaged (every fare line reconciles: 3.80 + 0.75 x 17.60 + 0.28 x 26 + 0.80 = 25.08). POL-GEN-01: rider's prior_disputes_upheld, rating etc. are context only and are not used. POL-GEN-05 not reached (no monetary effect). NO_SHOW clauses and amendments POL-NS-11/POL-NS-12 concern the other category and do not apply.
7. What would resolve it: an independent record of the route across 14:11:30-14:19:00 (platform full-resolution telemetry or a platform-derived actual distance independent of the driver export, or a driver statement). For the reviewer's money block, the POL-RD-02 figure if the deviation is confirmed: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 13.5 + 0.28 x 20) x 1.0 (surge from EV-FARE-04003) + 0.80 = 20.325; charged_total 25.08; refund 4.755 -> rounded up to 4.80 (PARTIAL_REFUND, below the 6.00 claimed and below the 8.00 execution threshold).
doubts: The straight line across the gap is a lower bound on distance actually driven, so actual distance is at least 17.600 km whatever happened in the gap, and the excess of 4.10 km (30.4%) passes POL-RD-01 even on the driver-favourable reading; the clean pre-gap section alone also shows the Buangkok loop. A reader who treats POL-RD-07(ii) as aimed only at cases where the gap could change the answer, or who reads the 'disputed segment' as only the clean Buangkok loop, would rule PARTIAL_REFUND of 4.80 under POL-RD-01/POL-RD-02 (not the 6.00 claimed). I reject that because POL-RD-07(ii) is categorical ('may NOT be established on the gps_trace alone'), the rider's complaint expressly covers the KPE/MCE stretch inside the gap, POL-RD-13 says POL-RD-10(3) still governs an impaired trace without corroboration, and the 0.6 weight independently forces POL-RD-10(1).
